messages:
incident-bot: ALERT — infra/embed-queue.p95_enqueue_latency exceeded threshold (current=1350ms, threshold=1200ms). Auto-paging to @oncall-sre. Rule: prod, region=us-west, severity=page.

ryan: ack, I'm on it. pulling metrics and logs now.

maria: +1, looking at customer-facing dashboards. do we have any 5xx customer spikes?

ryan: quick snapshot — small number of users (3 low-latency tenants) saw increased 5xx around 13:42. overall success rate still ~98%, but retries spiked. linking the chart: https://redwood.metrics/dashboard/embed-queue?range=15m

ajay: copying logs from worker pool: ```
Mar 03 13:41:59 worker-23 embed_enqueue latency=1350ms retries=2 pool=small-batch
Mar 03 13:42:02 worker-07 embed_enqueue latency=1289ms retries=3 pool=small-batch
```

ryan: hypothesis: burst of long prompt sequences killed small-batch workers and caused KV cache churn. KV eviction logs show frequent misses.

maria: customer impact: Juno Media reported ~10 failed embed calls in the timeframe — they errored with 504. I've pinged their SE to say we're investigating.

ajay: mitigation attempt 1: temporarily scale small-batch pool by +3 instances. Command: `infra scale worker small-batch --add 3 --reason "embed latency page"`

sre-bot: ACTION — scaled small-batch pool +3 (initiated by ajay). Expected to complete in ~60s.

ryan: seeing enqueue latency drop to ~700ms after scale. good. but we should avoid flip-flopping thresholds; this pattern might reoccur during long-sequence runs.

maria: post-incident items we need to handle in runbook and alerts:
- annotate the page with customer list and incident notes
- add dashboard panel for "KV cache eviction rate" near embed-queue charts
- adjust alert to include sustained-kv-eviction as a correlate to reduce noise
- assign runbook ownership for embed queue tuning

ryan: agreed. Proposed alert tuning: change p95_enqueue latency trigger to 1500ms for small-batch pool only, and add secondary correlated alert: kv_eviction_rate > 0.02 for 5m to auto-page. That should reduce pager noise for one-off bursts that resolve with autoscale.

ajay: +1 to correlated alert. also propose a debounce: require 3 consecutive p95 samples in 5m before paging.

maria: I'll make the runbook edits. Runbook link: https://playbooks.redwood/runbooks/embed-queue. Plan:
- Add section "alert tuning" with exact threshold values + rationale.
- Add annotated dashboard links and panels (panel ids added).
- Document oncall flow: scale -> monitor 10m -> rollback scale if stable -> notify customer if >10 failed requests.

ryan: please add an explicit ownership line: oncall team: eng-oncall; runbook owner: maria; backup: ajay. Also add an item to notify product when a customer hits >5% error-rate.

maria: doing now. Editing runbook: adding the alert rule snippet: ```yaml
alert: EmbedQueueHighP95
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(embed_enqueue_seconds_bucket[1m])) by (le, pool)) > 1.5
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
  pool: small-batch
annotations:
  runbook: https://playbooks.redwood/runbooks/embed-queue#alert-tuning
```

ajay: also added a dashboard panel request: Dashboard: Embed Queue (id: 1123) — new panels: KV eviction rate (panel 46), per-pool p95 (panel 47), per-customer 5xx trend (panel 48).

sre-bot: NOTE — leaving a persistent annotation in the incident: key actions = [scaled small-batch +3, alert updated draft, runbook annotated], owners = {maria, ajay}.

ryan: follow-up action items before close:
1) maria: push runbook changes and add links + ownership (ETA: 2h)
2) ajay: create dashboard panels + PR for grafana (ETA: 4h)
3) me (ryan): open a post-incident ticket to evaluate whether quantization or request-shaping would reduce peak load (ETA: 1d)
4) oncall: add a short note to paging policy: require correlated kv_eviction alert to page in low-traffic hours (quiet window exceptions documented)

maria: runbook PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/runbooks/pulls/58 — summary: bump p95 to 1.5s for small-batch, add kv_eviction correlation, add owner = maria, add dashboard links.

ajay: grafana PR: https://git.internal/grafana/dashboards/pulls/142 — adds panel 46/47/48.

ryan: leaving a short incident note for customer comms: "We observed transient enqueue latency due to a burst of long-sequence embedding requests. We scaled capacity which resolved the issue; we have tuned alerting and dashboards to reduce reoccurrence and will follow up with additional mitigations."

maria: tagging the runbook with incident id and adding the incident timeline note.

ajay: small postmortem to follow if we see recurrence. otherwise will close as mitigated.

ryan: closing the page. moving thread to post-incident channel for the writeup. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
